name: and yet, we dream
detailed_description:
welcome to the afterlife.

you died. hell is waiting. but an offer is made. there's one last chance to escape eternal damnation: spend a week in a middle-tier layer of the afterlife... working as a divine agent. uncover their secrets. understand their sins. decide their fate.

this is a boundary-pushing visual novel where every choice is heavy and every character is a psychological puzzle. though they wear the face of skeletons, the souls you meet are more human than you can imagine, with real histories, real traumas, real anxieties, and maybe even a reflection of yourself. the conversations are so authentic because they are based on real ones. you are, in a way, speaking with real people.

features:

  • deep narrative exploration: a story crafted with input from psychiatric professionals, delving into themes of morality, mortality, redemption and the human psyche.

  • characters based on real psychology: meet a cast of characters built on proven personality theories and archetypes.

  • unprecedented realism: the game's dialogues are based on transcripts of actual human conversations, with real people creating an experience of unparalleled authenticity.

  • choices with eternal consequences: morally complex choices with lasting impact.

  • completely hand-drawn art: a haunting, unforgettable atmosphere unlike anything you’ve experienced before.
